messages:
sam: Heads up — SF got absolutely soaked this morning. BART delay alerts all over :umbrella:  Anyone still trying to make it into the office?
rita: Yep I’m out but stuck under an awning waiting for a bus. MUNI is crawling. Hot tip: bring waterproof sneakers.
alex: Just saw a 20min delay on the app, redirected to shuttle. commute-bot: BART: Delays due to signal problem at Embarcadero — expect 15-25 minute delays.
nate: Oh no. I had a customer call in 30m. Thinking of switching to remote for the day. Anyone else doing that? :raised_hand:
maria: I’m WFH. Power flickered here in SOMA but fine now. Coffee’s a lifesaver. :coffee:
sam: Can someone check if the rooftop is leaking? My desk area smells like wet cardboard. :grimace:
alex: Build-failures channel said some deploys queued longer this morning, might be related to CI runners on the same zone? Not sure.
rita: Quick poll — who’s coming in later today when things calm down? Reply with :thumbsup: if yes, :thumbsdown: if staying home.
commute-bot: POLL: Coming in later today? Options: :thumbsup: Yes / :thumbsdown: No (poll expires in 2h)
nate: :thumbsdown: — remote for me. Got a plumbing leak at my apartment to handle too.
maria: :thumbsup: planning to come in around 2pm, will bring extra umbrellas.
sam: :thumbsdown: staying home, can cover async on the RFC.
alex: :thumbsdown: also remote — will hop on if the call needs me.
rita: :thumbsdown: sending a pic of the bus queue to #random-photos in a sec for proof.
maria: Also — if anyone needs a ride from Mission to SoMa later, I have two seats and dry car. DM me. :handshake:
sam: Thanks! Also tagging facilities to check the rooftop: @maria (facilities) can you poke the building folks?
maria (facilities): On it — I pinged building ops and put a maintenance request. ETA 45 min.
rita: Ok perfect. Stay safe everyone. If anyone needs snacks or dry socks, ping me — I’ve got extras in a backpack. :socks:
commute-bot: Reminder: check transit status pages before heading out — links: https://m.bart.gov, https://www.sfmta.com/
alex: Good call. Might make for an impromptu rainy-day meme thread later. :eyes:
